messages:
emily: Quick thread 1 rehearsal tomorrow 11am PT. Need final checklist for: registration UX, Zoom rehearsals, recording backups, and post-event email sequence. Owners?
marco: I'll run Zoom. Checklist:
- create meeting with 'Practice session' enabled
- cloud recording ON + auto-delete=90d
- record separate audio tracks
- live transcript ON
- co-hosts: marco, josh
- pre-assign breakout CSV (panelists in breakout 1)
- require passcode, waiting room for external attendees
- disable participant screen share by default
I'll run test recording Mon 11:15 and post link here. :gear:
rachel: Reg page notes:
- fields: first,last,email,company,role,team_size (dropdown), interest_area (checkboxes)
- hidden: utm_campaign, utm_medium, experiment_id
- GDPR consent checkbox (opt-in) 1 do not precheck
- confirmation email: include replay, slides link, "Talk to sales" CTA
HubSpot mapping:
- create contact + set property webinar_2026_apr=true
- lifecycle_stage=MQL if team_size > 50 or role contains "lead"/"manager"
- source=utm_medium
I'll push live by EOD.
josh: Post-event follow-up plan:
- attendees: email 1hr after w/ recording + slide deck + 1-click book demo link
- no-shows: email 3hr after w/ highlights + 1-question poll
- highly engaged (watch_pct>50) -> auto assign to SDR queue w/ note + watch transcript
- tag contacts: "webinar_apr_2026" and add UTM source
- enrichment: pass company domain to Clearbit enrichment webhook
I can own SDR routing.
zoom-bot: meeting 1802209100 created "Deep Dive: Inference Tradeoffs" scheduled 2026-04-13 18:00 UTC 1 cloud_recording=on, live_transcript=on, passcode=required.
emily: Two quick asks:
1) Where to upload hi-res slides? (prefer GDrive > marketing/assets/webinars/2026-04-inference)
2) Who will export VTT and retain master recording after 90d for enterprise requests?
marco: I'll upload VTT + master MP4 to GDrive after processing; will also store copy in S3: s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-04-inference/master.mp4
rachel: I'll finalise confirmation email copy: options subject lines in doc, short preview text, and RSVP calendar attachment. Will also set link tracking params.
emily: Action summary:
- marco: Zoom test Mon 11:15, export VTT + upload master recording to GDrive & S3
- rachel: reg page live, confirmation email copy, slides upload link
- josh: SDR routing, engagement thresholds, assign webhook
I'll send calendar invites for rehearsal and rehearsal run-through notes. :rocket:
